suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: no license file at the repository root
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

At revision `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` the repository has no license file at its root.

## Environment

- Repository: aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript
- Revision: `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` (the upstream revision this report was verified against)

## Steps to reproduce

```
git ls-tree --name-only 66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4
gh api repos/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript --jq .license
```

## Expected

A license file at the repository root (for example `LICENSE`), so GitHub license detection and package scanners, which read only the root, can identify the license.

## Actual

The root listing has no license file, and none exists elsewhere in the tree. `package.json` declares the license as `MIT`.
